findings.title: Router fallback can leave override allowed set
findings.problem: When user-scoped resolution raises NotFoundException/ModelNotWhitelistedException, or the resolved model is not a router candidate, _agenerate silently switches to router default_model, which is not checked against the user's override allowed_models. Other exceptions (DB errors from the self-opened session) are not caught at all.
findings.impact: A user restricted by an override can be served a model outside override.allowed_models on router calls. Reachability of the candidate-miss branch was not confirmed (depends on router candidates vs override lists).
findings.recommendation: On fallback pick the first router candidate that is in the override's allowed_models (preferring override.default_model), and only use router default_model when no override applies; add tests for both branches.

findings.title: Override outlives project membership
findings.problem: Membership is checked only at grant time in set_override. If the user is later removed from the project, the override row remains and still applies at resolution and listing; delete_all_by_project exists but nothing removes a single user's rows on membership removal.
findings.impact: Stale override re-applies and can widen model access if the user is re-added, or persist unnoticed. Spec does not state the intended lifecycle. Reachability unconfirmed.
findings.recommendation: Decide intent: delete override on UserProject removal, ignore overrides for non-members at resolve time, or accept and document admin manual cleanup in the spec.

findings.title: Non-member user error contract inconsistent
findings.problem: set_override raises ValueError (HTTP 400) for a user who is not a project member and has no user-existence check. Spec 4.1 asks for 400 for user-not-in-project, while spec 5.1 and the test plan list NotFoundException('User not found') (404).
findings.impact: Spec criterion 5.1 is partially met; clients cannot rely on one status code. The spec is internally inconsistent, so the correct behaviour needs a human decision.
findings.recommendation: Pick one contract and align spec and code: either update 5.1/test plan to 400, or add a user-existence check raising NotFoundException('User not found') (404) before the membership check.

findings.title: AgentNode.init_assistant override path untested
findings.problem: No test makes resolve_user_override_model return a model in AgentNode.init_assistant and asserts the assistant is built with it and project resolution skipped, nor the None case. The only init_assistant test was weakened to model_copy.assert_not_called().
findings.impact: Workflow agent nodes could ignore the user's override (dropped arguments, inverted precedence, removed branch) and tests would still pass.
findings.recommendation: Add tests patching ModelAvailabilityService.resolve_user_override_model to return 'override-model' (assert initialize_assistant gets model_copy(update={'model': 'override-model'}) and resolve_execution_model not called) and to return None (project resolution used).
